profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in New York, NY, trading under the ticker DDOG with CIK 0001561550. It is also known as DATADOG INC - CLASS A. The company's website describes its offering as cloud monitoring as a service, allowing users to see metrics from all of their apps, tools and services in one place.

The site's security and observability material focuses on defending against AI-powered attacks. It describes integrating security and observability to decode runtime execution, eliminate exposure in dynamic AI environments, and execute detection and response with what it calls agentic speed. No specific AI product names are given.

The company has 448 New York law exposure records and no recorded litigation cases.
